title.narrative: Empowering Persons with Psychosocial Disabilities to Fight for their Rights: an implementation of the CRPD and QualityRights principles in Ghana, Lebanon, and Armenia

description.narrative: The general objective of Lot 4 is to promote the full and equal enjoyment of all human rights and fundamental freedoms by all persons with disabilities, and to promote respect for their inherent dignity. People with psychosocial disabilities are often discriminated and experience violations of their human rights. Poor quality is a feature of many mental health services, where people with psychosocial disabilities are exposed to inhuman treatments and have no right to make their own decisions.
